Source: https://github.com/markziemann/pathway_confint

## Intro

Here we want to select 100 papers that did enrichment analysis.
We want to know:

* What tool was used for enrichment

* What prioritisation was reported

* From the data shown, what type of prioritisation was done

```{r,libs}

library("kableExtra")

```

## Read Survey data

```{r,load_data}

x <- read.csv("toppapers_results.tsv",sep="\t")
head(x)
colnames(x)

```

## Tools used

```{r,tools_used}

unique(x$Tool)
sort(table(x$Tool),decreasing=TRUE)

```

## Selection of significant pathways

Here is what the articles say about what results are considered significant.

```{r,selection}

x$Selection.stated

sort(table(x$Selection.stated),decreasing=TRUE)
sort(table(x$Selection.type),decreasing=TRUE)

```

## Prioritisation stated

```{r,prioritisation}

x$Prioritisation.stated
sort(table(x$Prioritisation.stated),decreasing=TRUE)


x$Prioritisation.stated.type
sort(table(x$Prioritisation.stated.type),decreasing=TRUE)

x$Prioritisation.observed
sort(table(x$Prioritisation.observed),decreasing=TRUE)

x$Prioritisation.observed.type
sort(table(x$Prioritisation.observed.type),decreasing=TRUE)

sort(table(subset(x,Prioritisation.observed.type == "Surrogate effect")$Prioritisation.observed),decreasing=TRUE)

```
